sermon.title: The Bible and Slavery 08/26/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer answers the claim that the Bible approves of slavery: Exodus 21:16 makes kidnapping a capital crime, debt servants were not slaves, and forced slavery harms people, so it is unbiblical. He then turns to modern slavery and child sex trafficking and calls Christians to weep and stand up for children.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: A video of Barack Obama speaking is played around 4:45–6:25; those words are not the pastor’s. He cites “Luke 9:53” for “whoever receives this child in my name” (Luke 9:48). Statistics on slavery, trafficking, runaways and foster care are kept as spoken and were not checked. Contains graphic descriptions of child sexual abuse and mentions images shown in the service (21:50–27:00; 36:44–37:40).
